messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.reasoning:
The user asks: Who is the most assist player in Premier League? They want presumably current or overall record? Likely they mean top assists leader historically. Could use data from known stats: As of recent seasons, players like Kevin De Bruyne has many assists; but all-time leading assist provider in EPL is Ryan Giggs (not sure). Actually all-time assists leaders: Ryan Giggs had 162 assists. But more recently, people ask about who leads currently.

We need to respond appropriately. We can provide answer and maybe mention source. No tool needed because it's not asking for dynamic query. So just give info. Provide context: All time vs current season. Probably best to say as of latest full season, the highest assist count was X by Y. Or if question ambiguous, clarify. We'll assume they want historical all-time. Let's answer accordingly.
